senses.sense_definition: To warm one's body or body parts thoroughly.

senses.sense_definition: A mechanism in PostgreSQL databases for storing large attributes.

examples.text: The database administrator configured <w>TOAST</w> to handle the oversized rows efficiently.

target_lang_translations.nl: De databasebeheerder heeft <w>TOAST</w> geconfigureerd om de te grote rijen efficiënt te verwerken.

examples.text: Understanding how <w>TOAST</w> works is essential for optimizing storage in this system.
